## Summary

Added `_validate_available_capital()` to `freqtrade/configuration/config_validation.py`, wired into `validate_config_consistency()` alongside the other startup sanity checks (trailing stoploss, demo trading, etc.). It fires a `ConfigurationError` if both `available_capital` and `tradable_balance_ratio` are present in the user's raw config — before JSON-schema defaults get injected, so the default `tradable_balance_ratio: 0.99` doesn't cause false positives for users who never touched that setting.

The check needed to run before the schema-defaulting step (the last line of `validate_config_consistency`), since `tradable_balance_ratio` has a schema default that would otherwise mask whether the user actually set it.

Also fixed three existing tests (`test_wallets.py::test_get_starting_balance`, `test_wallets.py::test_get_trade_stake_amount_unlimited_amount`, `test_hyperopt.py::test_max_open_trades_consistency`) that were constructing configs with both settings simultaneously — that's exactly the misconfiguration this check now catches, so those fixtures now drop `tradable_balance_ratio` when `available_capital` is set. Added a new test `test__validate_available_capital` covering both the failure and pass cases.

Full test suite (4336 tests, excluding an unrelated pre-existing `lightgbm`/`libomp` environment issue) passes.
